title: MiniMax H3 public benchmark record
scope: Sanitized execution statistics extracted from local benchmark evidence. Prompts, media, reference paths, provider IDs, and named-subject records are excluded.

dataDictionary.elapsedSeconds: Observed end-to-end or execution time reported by the source record.
dataDictionary.samplingSeconds: Sampler-node time when the evidence recorded it separately.
dataDictionary.requested: Requested generation contract normalized to dimensions, duration, fps, steps, and native audio.
dataDictionary.media: Observed output probe values; null means the source record did not include that field.
dataDictionary.samplerWasCached: Explicit source flag only. Null means the source did not make this assertion.
dataDictionary.cachedNodeCount: Number of graph nodes reported as reused by the source record.
dataDictionary.likelyCachedReplay: Derived flag: explicit cached sampler, or reused nodes combined with zero recorded sampler time. Exclude from performance rankings.
dataDictionary.source: Relative evidence locator. No absolute local path is included.
